title: Blueberator's PVP pack
body:
### Information

The **Blueberator's PVP pack** is a texture pack that changes all kinds of **weapons** _(sword, spear, mace etc.)_, combat related **items** _(enderpearl, golden apple, bucket, wool)_ and **armor**. It has a simple style and is perfect for **PVP** use.

Works well with my other GUI mod that also has a smaller **crosshair** that you can check out **[here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/blueberators-dark-gui)**.
